parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, attached to the side storage section of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a cover for the storage compartment, allowing access to internal shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: Another cabinet door made of MDF, similar to the first one, located on the lower section of the side storage.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment of the table.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel made of particle board, forming the structural side of the table’s cabinet section.
parts.Functional_description: It provides vertical support and defines the side boundary of the storage area.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: Another vertical side panel made of particle board, opposite to the previous one, completing the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural stability and supports the tabletop and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A bottom panel made of particle board, forming the base of the cabinet section.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and connects the vertical panels.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A cylindrical steel leg supporting one side of the tabletop.
parts.Functional_description: It provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: Another cylindrical steel leg supporting the opposite side of the tabletop.
parts.Functional_description: It provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Partition Plate (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal partition plate made of particle board, dividing the cabinet space into sections.
parts.Functional_description: It separates the storage compartments and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.material: Laminate Wood (MDF core with laminate surface)
parts.Basic_description: A flat tabletop made of MDF with a laminate surface, rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main working surface for writing, placing objects, or using a computer.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
